persona.label: Unclear and disorganised
persona.description: Hard to interview. Rambles, misreads questions, needs the frequency scale re-explained, discloses out of order. Tests whether the agent can actively guide rather than merely transcribe.

conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s been… kind of hard to sort out. Since I moved to Toronto for work, I’ve been feeling low a lot, not sleeping properly, and I just don’t feel interested in things the way I used to. I’ve got hardly any friends here, so I end up kind of keeping to myself. I also skip meals sometimes, and I’ve been avoiding video calls with my family back home, which feels bad because I’m close to them. It’s been going on for about five months now.
